state.title: naoqi_rest

part.text:
The robot followed the corridor to the red wall and is now in front of it. Both sonars read about 0.7 m, and the red wall fills the camera view. I then called rest, and it crouched with the motors off.

I'd estimate the stopping distance at roughly 0.7 m from the wall. There were no falls during the run.
